crossRefs.note: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

people.name: Oboth
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during the Exodus

people.name: Punon
people.line: A stopping place for the Israelites in the wilderness

translations.web: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
translations.bsb: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
translations.kjv: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
